sender.ms: Nombor kawan atau saudara anda sendiri, yang sudah diambil alih
sender.en: Your own friend's or relative's number, which has been taken over

name.ms: Akaun WhatsApp diambil alih melalui pautan “kad jemputan” atau kod pengesahan, kemudian kenalan diminta pinjam wang
name.en: WhatsApp account taken over through an “invitation” link or verification code, then contacts are asked for a loan

how.ms: Anda menerima pautan kad jemputan kahwin atau mesej lain daripada nombor kenalan, atau seseorang meminta kod pengesahan WhatsApp enam digit yang dihantar kepada anda. Selepas anda menekan pautan atau memberikan kod, akaun WhatsApp anda diambil alih dan anda terkunci keluar. Penjenayah kemudian menggunakan akaun anda untuk menghantar pautan yang sama dan meminta wang daripada kenalan anda, kononnya pinjaman segera. MCMC mengingatkan orang ramai supaya tidak berkongsi kod pengesahan atau PIN keselamatan.
how.en: You get a wedding invitation link or another message from a contact's number, or someone asks for the six-digit WhatsApp verification code that was sent to you. Once you tap the link or give the code, your WhatsApp account is taken over and you are locked out. The criminals then use your account to send the same link and ask your contacts for money, supposedly an urgent loan. MCMC reminds people never to share verification codes or security PINs.

text.ms: Mesej daripada nombor kenalan dengan pautan “kad jemputan”, atau permintaan kod enam digit yang “terhantar salah”.
text.en: A message from a contact's number with an “invitation” link, or a request for a six-digit code “sent by mistake”.

text.ms: Anda menekan pautan atau memberikan kod pengesahan WhatsApp.
text.en: You tap the link or give the WhatsApp verification code.

text.ms: Akaun anda diambil alih dan anda tidak boleh log masuk lagi.
text.en: Your account is taken over and you can no longer log in.

text.ms: Kenalan anda menerima mesej “daripada anda” yang meminta pinjaman segera ke akaun lain.
text.en: Your contacts get messages “from you” asking for an urgent loan to another account.

text.ms: Salam, maaf ganggu. Tadi saya tersalah hantar kod 6 digit ke nombor awak, boleh tolong forward balik kod tu? Penting sangat ni.
text.en: Hi, sorry to bother you. I sent a 6-digit code to your number by mistake earlier, can you forward the code back to me? It's really important.

text.ms: Bro, aku ada masalah sikit ni, boleh pinjam RM2,000 dulu? Transfer ke akaun kawan aku ni ya, akaun aku kena sekat. Esok aku bayar balik, jangan call dulu aku tengah meeting.
text.en: Bro, I've got a bit of a problem, can I borrow RM2,000 first? Transfer it to my friend's account, mine is blocked. I'll pay you back tomorrow, don't call, I'm in a meeting.

ms: Sesiapa yang meminta kod pengesahan WhatsApp, walaupun kawan sendiri.
Pautan “kad jemputan” yang meminta anda log masuk atau memasukkan nombor telefon.
Kawan yang tiba-tiba perlu pinjam wang ke akaun orang lain dan tidak mahu ditelefon.
en: Anyone asking for your WhatsApp verification code, even a friend.
An “invitation” link that asks you to log in or enter your phone number.
A friend who suddenly needs a loan paid into someone else's account and won't take a call.

ms: Jangan berikan kod pengesahan atau PIN WhatsApp kepada sesiapa. Aktifkan pengesahan dua langkah.
Jika kawan meminta wang, telefon dia di nombor lama atau tanya secara bersemuka sebelum memindahkan.
Jika akaun anda diambil alih, cuba pulihkannya melalui saluran rasmi WhatsApp, maklumkan kenalan anda, dan adukan kepada MCMC jika masih tidak selesai.
en: Never give your WhatsApp verification code or PIN to anyone. Turn on two-step verification.
If a friend asks for money, call them on their usual number or ask in person before sending anything.
If your account is taken over, try to recover it through WhatsApp's official channels, warn your contacts, and complain to MCMC if it is still not solved.

sources.title: Beware of sly invite links stealing money

story.ms: Seorang pemimpin persatuan di Kuala Lumpur menekan pautan kad jemputan kahwin yang dihantar kepadanya oleh seorang pesara polis, lalu terkunci keluar dari akaun WhatsApp sendiri. Sekurang-kurangnya seorang kenalannya memindahkan kira-kira RM3,000 ke akaun yang diberikan penipu, menyangka ia pinjaman untuknya.
story.en: An association leader in Kuala Lumpur tapped a wedding invitation link sent to him by a retired policeman, and was locked out of his own WhatsApp account. At least one of his contacts sent about RM3,000 to the account the scammer gave, thinking it was a loan for him.
